title: Delhi Police deny CJP nod for Oct 10 protest; Saurav Das asks, ‘Who are they?’

This protest is scheduled for October 10, demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation. Police have denied permission for the planned demonstration, questioning the need for such an approval. CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke claimed activists in Maharashtra are facing pressure to refrain from attending the protest.

title: Gujarat: Married woman, lover forced into public sex as ‘punishment’
content: A shocking incident occurred in Surendranagar where a couple was subjected to horrific punishment by the woman's husband. After the couple was located, police arrested nine individuals involved in the brutal acts. The couple was reportedly filmed during the ordeal, which was shared on social media. Authorities were alerted by local community leaders who facilitated the police intervention.

title: Why RBI hiked repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5% in the MPC review
content: Two factors worked to decide MPC’s move: inflationary pressures persist and growth is beating estimates. Hence, a hike in repo rate, while helping keep inflation in check, is unlikely to substantially impact GDP growth. The Indian economy has remained robust, with growth momentum spread across various segments. The committee expects the economy to retain its resilience.

title: Bezos Academy opened its largest preschool in Texas; offers free education
content: Bezos Academy has launched its largest preschool in Texas, named Bezos Academy Denton, to serve local families. The school features six classrooms and can accommodate up to 120 children with free Montessori programming. A partnership with Texas Woman’s University and the City of Denton facilitated the construction of the $6 million facility. Future enrollment opportunities can be explored through the academy’s website despite current full enrollment.

title: Rajasthan HC orders Pocso convict Asaram's release on 20-day parole
content: Rajasthan High Court has directed the state government to release Pocso convict Asaram on a 20-day parole. The court emphasized that the previous orders allowing his parole are still operative and valid. Additionally, there was no legal basis shown by the state that invalidated the parole. Asaram's previous conviction in Gujarat did not hinder the Rajasthan court's decision.

title: Man deposits Rs 85.3 lakh given to him as cash gifts, gets notice; ITAT gives relief
content: In one such case in Chennai, a man received cash gifts of Rs 85.03 lakh from his relatives. The Income Tax Department began making enquiries into the source of the Rs 85.03 lakh deposited by the man. The department also sent tax notices to the relatives who had given him the cash.  The man eventually won relief in ITAT Chennai.

title: Two candidates die during police constable recruitment run, heart attack suspected
content: Two candidates participating in the UP Police constable recruitment physical tests collapsed and died in hospital. Vivek Kumar from Shamli and Atul Kumar from Mathura were among the candidates. Both candidates reportedly experienced severe health issues during the 4.8km run required for male applicants. Officials are investigating the circumstances surrounding their deaths while autopsy reports are awaited.

title: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has conquered the hype. Now comes the hard part: Waiting
content: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's meteoric rise has now brought him a new challenge: waiting. With head coach Gautam Gambhir backing Sanju Samson for the West Indies T20Is, the 15-year-old teenage sensation must now learn to navigate a lonely wait on the bench in international cricket.

title: Meet Nick Grewal, Entrepreneur of the Year who built two global tech companies
content: Nick Grewal, founder of ePropelled, has been recognized with the 2026 Entrepreneur of the Year Award. He received the accolade at the Innovation Summit in Nashua, honoring his technology advancements. Grewal previously founded Nashoba Networks, leading to Cisco's acquisition in 1996, expanding his career in technology. His recent venture, ePropelled, focuses on electric propulsion systems for uncrewed vehicles and energy management.

title: American man says simple Indian food cured his asthma and allergies
content: American influencer Samuel Hillclimber is stirring up discussions with his amusing claims about Indian cuisine. In a recently shared video, he attributes the cure of his asthma and allergies to aloo bhujia, igniting playful banter among his Indian audience. Viewers humorously speculate on the potential health benefits of other traditional dishes, turning what could be a serious medical topic into a light-hearted culinary exchange.

title: Claude Code creator Boris Cherny on what not to miss while prompting Claude
content: Boris Cherny advocates for a more conversational style when engaging with AI models like Claude. He believes that prioritizing the intended outcome leads to superior results, instead of relying solely on rigid instructions. By clarifying goals, input effort, and methods for validation, users can enhance interaction. An illustrative prompt reveals essential business insights from a podcast, signifying a transformative approach to prompting AI in contemporary settings.

title: Why children touch a parent’s face while talking, according to psychology
content: Children frequently display physical affection towards their parents, such as gently touching their faces while talking. This interaction not only nurtures a sense of closeness but also helps them assess their parents' engagement. Studies indicate that such affectionate gestures are crucial for emotional growth throughout childhood. Parents must recognize the importance of these moments while also upholding appropriate boundaries to enhance emotional safety and deepen the parent-child relationship.

title: And thereby hangs a tale! Jeffrey Archer’s Delhi connect
content: Jeffrey Archer's novels resonated with Indian readers and left a lasting impact on their literary preferences. His interactions in Delhi included book signings and conversations about cricket and writing. Many fans remember personal anecdotes he shared during events, showcasing his humor and relatability. Archer's storytelling captivated readers, fostering anticipation for his book releases over many years. His death signifies a significant loss, closing a chapter in a generation's reading experience.

title: Mercedes, 5-star hotel, hockey sticks: Nagaland woman's Delhi night out turns violent
content: A 28-year-old woman from Nagaland reported harassment and assault involving her friends at The Ashok hotel. The incident took place during the early hours of October 4, when two groups clashed in the parking area. The woman alleged that men in a car tried to abduct her and attacked her friends with hockey sticks. Police collected evidence, including blood samples, while no arrests were made so far.

title: CJP announces 'Chappal protest' in Bengaluru; actor Prakash Raj to join stir
content: On October 8, the CJP will conduct a 'Chappal protest' at Freedom Park in Bengaluru. The protest follows a People's Tribunal discussing the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Civil society groups are concerned about voters being incorrectly removed from the list. They are demanding that deletions from the SIR be reversed and that the electoral rolls from before SIR be retained.

title: ‘History will be kinder to you’: Gautam Gambhir bids farewell to Ajit Agarkar
content: Gautam Gambhir expressed his gratitude to Ajit Agarkar after Agarkar's tenure as chief selector ended. During Agarkar's time, India achieved significant success in ICC tournaments, including three trophy victories. Pragyan Ojha has been appointed interim chairman of selectors while the BCCI invites applications for a permanent replacement. VVS Laxman will be present at future selection meetings to improve communication with the Centre of Excellence.

title: RBI raises interest rates, hikes FY27 growth forecast by 40 bps and inflation by 20 bps
content: In a notable move, the Reserve Bank of India has adjusted the repo rate, increasing it by 25 basis points to 5.50%. This adjustment comes in response to stronger-than-anticipated economic growth alongside rising price pressures. Additionally, the RBI has updated its FY27 GDP growth prediction to 7.1%, indicating optimistic economic performance. Meanwhile, inflation forecasts have been revised upwards, predicting Consumer Price Index inflation to hover around 5.8%.

title: From parents' struggles to 'endless coffees': How Savitha won India's only gold medal
content: In the final installment of TimesofIndia.com's series looking back at India's medal-winning campaigns at the Chess Olympiad in Samarkand, Savitha Shri opens up about her remarkable breakthrough as India's only individual gold medallist. The 19-year-old recalls arriving as a reserve, playing all 10 rounds and delivering when India needed her most, while discussing her family's sacrifices, the team's bronze, Swayams Mishra's support and her goal of becoming a Grandmaster.

title: Jaguar Type 01 unveiled: 1,016 hp electric GT with 643 km range
content: Jaguar has introduced the Type 01, a new all-electric four-door grand tourer, which will begin production in 2027. This model utilizes Jaguar's dedicated Electric Architecture and features a tri-motor powertrain. It is expected to deliver up to 1,030 PS and provide an EPA range of up to 643 kilometers. The car offers a four-seat cabin with advanced display technology and unique audio features.

title: 'They paid Rs 300 only': How payment dispute turned deadly for elderly couple
content: Ramesh Kapoor, his wife Rajni, and their house help Tilya Devi were found murdered in Dehradun. The couple had an argument with plumber Raj Kumar over payment for work done. During the altercation, Raj Kumar attacked the couple and fatally stabbed Tilya Devi when she intervened. A screwdriver was recovered at the crime scene and is believed to be the murder weapon.

title: 'Blessed once again': Kiara Advani announces second pregnancy with Sidharth Malhotra
content: Kiara Advani and Sidharth Malhotra are expecting their second child. Kiara shared a photo of daughter Saraayah holding a tiny white sock, captioned "Blessed once again with the greatest gift of all." The couple, who bonded on Shershaah, married in Jaisalmer in February 2023 and welcomed Saraayah in July 2025.

title: 3 tennis players killed, 3 injured after car rams truck on Purvanchal Expressway
content: Four young cricketers tragically lost their lives in a car crash on the Purvanchal Expressway. They were traveling back to Deoria from a cricket match in Lucknow. Two other passengers sustained serious injuries and were taken to Medical College for treatment. Police have started an investigation into the incident while searching for the unidentified truck involved. The group was reportedly asleep at the time of the accident.

title: Harmanpreet's captaincy: 211 matches, one WC and a debate that never went away
content: From a stand-in captain in 2012 to India's first women's ODI World Cup-winning skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur's 14-year captaincy produced 211 matches, 126 wins and eight title or gold-medal finishes. It also brought repeated questions over her leadership, batting and record against Australia. Her resignation closes a captaincy era that delivered the trophy India had waited for, while leaving the T20 World Cup and a long-running succession debate finally resolved.

title: From Shakti to Aravalli: India's helicopter engine journey takes shape
content: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh inaugurated a second production line for Shakti helicopter engines at HAL's Koraput division. This facility is expected to be fully operational by 2028-29 and will produce up to 100 engines annually. HAL is also increasing the production capacity of AL-31FP engines for the Su-30MKI to support aircraft operations. The Shakti engine development exemplifies India's progress in aerospace technology and indigenous manufacturing capabilities.

title: Sick leave approved, but SBI declared his job ‘voluntarily vacated’: Why HC stepped in
content: In a significant ruling, the Patna high court reinstated a State Bank of India employee who was wrongly deemed to have abandoned his role after taking medical leave for health issues. The court highlighted the bank's failure to appropriately manage his medical documents, ultimately reinstating him without pay for the duration of his absence. This case underlines the critical importance of adhering to employment protocols.

title: Grandfather shoots grandson dead: How blood splatters exposed killing in Lonavla
content: Abhay Marathe, a 33-year-old lawyer, was found dead from a bullet injury in Lonavla. His family initially claimed the shooting was accidental while he cleaned his grandfather's rifle. However, police investigation revealed inconsistencies and evidence of a dispute over property. Abhay's grandfather Motiram Marathe has been charged with murder, and four relatives are accused of destroying evidence.

title: Opposition's anti-SIR-CEC march turns into INDIA bloc-government face-off

Despite police attempts to remove the protesters, several MPs entered the Akashvani premises and continued their demonstration. Rahul Gandhi criticized Prime Minister Modi and accused his government of treasonous actions against the country.

title: Astronomers find ‘phoenix planet’ born from ashes of a dying star
content: A team of astronomers has discovered a second-generation planet orbiting a white dwarf named HS 0209+0832. This planet formed from the material that the white dwarf expelled during its death. The atmosphere of the white dwarf contains heavy elements such as zinc, copper, and niobium. This discovery could change the way astronomers search for similar planets around dead stars.

title: ‘This is merely the beginning’: Congress warns Gyanesh after INDIA bloc protest
content: Congress MP Pawan Khera warned the government that the inDIA bloc protest against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar was only the beginning . he said those in power should “mend their ways right now” and warned that the public would “bring down those who are currently riding the high horse of arrogance” .

title: Texas man faces execution for killing convenience store clerk in 2000

title: Another sleeper bus on fire, lucky escape for 32 as driver decides to stop
content: the bus was on its way to Muzaffarpur in Bihar Noida: 32 passengers had a narrow escape . the driver of both buses smelt something burning, saw smoke coming out of the dashboard and stopped before the flames could trap those inside . on sept 23, the driver and attendant of the bus headed for Mahoba in UP turned a deaf ear to repeated warnings .

title: New SC judges take oath, all in the name of God; women judges in SC only 3 out of 37
content: justices Sunita Agarwal, Devendra Kumar Upadhyaya and Singh took oath of office . they were chief justices of Gujarat, Delhi and Telangana HCs . the strength of women judges in the apex court at present became three .

title: 'Come to your senses': What is Pak PM's condition for talks with Imran's party
content: shehbaz's talks offer fails to sway PTI as long march presses on imran Khan-led Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf . he calls it "merely symbolic" and says the government has taken no concrete step beyondextending the invitation .

title: Protest against CEC: FIR against Rahul, Priyanka over entry into Akashvani Bhawan
content: Priyanka and Rahul were briefly detained after an 8-hour sit-in at the Akashvani Bhawan premises . the protest began after police stopped inDIA bloc MPs from marching towards the election commission's office .

title: ‘We will do it’: PM Modi gives new slogan for Viksit Bharat, self-reliant India by 2047
content: people welcomed PM Modi on his arrival by showering flowers, waving BJP flags and chanting ‘Bharat Mata ki Jai’ . the prime minister attributed his political journey to the faith and support of the people .

title: Priscilla Chan’s fund gives $330,000 to all 23 Kauaʻi public schools
content: all 23 public and charter schools receive a share of the funding . the unrestricted grants give school leaders flexibility to direct the money towards their most pressing needs . Priscilla Chan’s $330,000 Kauai schools funding gives all 23 schools flexibility .

title: Kharge to host INDIA bloc lunch as oppn plans next move after ‘vote chori’ protest
content: a day after the march was stopped by police near Akashvani Bhawan . indian bloc MPs marched towards the Election Commission and staged a sit-in . Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge is set to host opposition MPs for lunch .

title: 'Money is Ata Pata Laapata': SC directs Rajpal to pay Rs 2 crore by Oct 13
content: the court directed actor Rajpal Yadav to deposit Rs 2 crore towards the amount due to the complainant in a cheque-bounce case by Oct 13 . he brought a demand draft of Rs 1.15 crore, while the remaining Rs 85 lakh is to be paid by October 13 through a buyer of his property .

title: In saris and slippers, Ramgarh women run for a govt job dream
content: some NGO workers provided Kavita with tracksuit and other items after the video went viral . it is a chance to step out of poverty, secure their children’s education and bring stability to their families Aspirants gather at Sidhu-Kanhu ground to prepare for the recruitment drive Kavita Kumari practises for the 1.6km run women in tracksuits run alongside homemakers in saris .

title: 'Islam wanting to take over': Donald Trump reacts to France school protests
content: more than 266,000 people took part in nationwide demonstrations on tuesday, including 56,000 in Paris . the protests began at a high school in the region in mid-September . police fired tear gas and clashed with protesters in Paris after an otherwise peaceful march .
